nom: Paula's Choice Skin Recovery Hydrating Treatment Mask

avis.texte: To begin, I actually bought this stuff and I am in no way being paid to write a review. Haven’t yet figured out how to get in on that scam. Looking for a side hustle, so any fake reviewers out there, hit me up. I’m poor. Picture is early morning on no sleep (dem bags, tho) and I wasn’t trying to look pretty, just showing off my not-flaking and not-breaking-out-horrendously skin. This stuff is fantastic. I waited to write a review to see how my skin responded. I use this as an overnight mask, over my serums and regular moisturizer, and I’m finally waking up without tight skin. My skin is dry but also breaks out easily if a product doesn’t agree, and a lot of heavy moisturizers have made the congestion around my mouth and forehead worse, but not this stuff. I also love that it’s fragrance free, because that tends to irritate my skin. I went to get a facial recently and the esthetician felt my skin and kept commenting on how hydrated it felt and that I must take good care of my skin. A month ago I would not have gotten that compliment. I’m going through this stuff faster than I anticipated because it also makes a great hand moisturizer. My cuticles stay moisturized long after I apply it. 10/10 would buy again.

Paula's Choice Recovery Mask really does what it says it's going to do.Since I am switching over to this skin care line I have been trying several of their product's but I have started ordering from them directly however occasionally I will buy some of PC from Amazon such as this Mask.I am prescribed Tretinoin gel which is pretty potent and much stonger than any over the counter Retinol.While I am completely happy with the results I get using my prescription I also found that it dryed out my face so bad.That being said while my face has improved all around I am now dealing with severe dry skin and this Mask delivered the hydration my face so desperately needed.I apply this at night after I wash and Tone, I do leave it on over night and rinse off when I get up in the Morning and all I can say is wow ! My skin has no more dry patches nor do I look like I haven't slept in weeks.The final results for me are my face looks and feels smooth and has a nice natural glow and of course leaves my skin very moisturized.I like this is a big tube because I will be using this at least 3x a week and on nights I don't use this I have other PC products I use that also are amazing.I find this Skin Care line to live up to it's claims and the prices are afforadable compared to other products I have used that didn't deliver like these.

I have only used this mask/moisturizer twice, but even after the first night, I could notice a big improvement in my skin. It looked more hydrated, smoother, and plumped up, which made my wrinkles appear less pronounced. When I put on makeup for Christmas Eve, I was so much happier with my skin and how flawlessly my foundation went on. I just felt more confident with how I looked, and let me tell you, at 67 years old, that hasn't happened for a very long time. I can't say enough good things about this product! Love it!

I have combo skin that tends to get very dry in some places in the winter. I have tried a handful of Paula's Choice products and tend to love them all. I want to rate this 5 stars, but the only thing holding me back is that I apply as a part of my night time routine, and my skin still feels a bit dry in the am. Other factors that could play into this is living in a cold dry climate where my furnace is on and it's really hard to combat that level of dryness in the air. I also don't know if it's possible for my skin type to ever be fully moisturized after 8+ hours of wear. Things to note that I love about this product: I have used it every day for about a month and it has not caused any breakouts It is scent free Although it is a heavier cream, it doesn't feel cakey or greasy Also, I have it on subscribe and save so I do plan to continue to use it!

It's OK... But just OK. I have been sleeping in a moisture mask for the better part of 3 years. I do this to combat the dryness that I experience as a result of my retinol serum. I decided to try the Paula's Choice mask because I had read so many glowing reviews and I really respect Paula's scientific approach to skincare. This product goes on smooth, and feels moisturizing. However, my skin did not look quiet as good, nor did it feel quiet as moisturized as it had in the past. I gave this product a month trial, and in the end am left feeling un-impressed. It moisturized, but didn't really soothe. I feel like lines that are cropping up on my forehead actually became a little more noticeable. Needless to say, I will not be using this product again. For reference, I am 29 years old and a skincare junkie.

I have very dry skin to the point my face was flaking no matter what I tried. After one use this has cleared up probably 90% of the flaking and I didn't have to reapply after an hour or 2. I also have sensitive skin and this hasn't caused any irritation. It is fragrance free so it just smells like the ingredients which isn't the best smell but it is so mild it is gone within a few minutes. I didn't want this to work as well as it does due to the price, but it is well worth it and a little product goes a long way.

avis.titre: My face and hands are so smooth
avis.texte: Amazing product. I bought it as part of my skin routine. I’m 59 yrs old. It’s so soft and works really well. I actually put a little on my heels overnight and they are so soft. No smell which is great. Highly recommend to lessen dryness and make your skin feel incredible.
I love this thick cream. It keeps my face hydrated - even overnight - and keeps dark spots from appearing. Also like the fact it has no fragrance.

avis.titre: More a heavy moisturer or night cream than a mask.
avis.texte: I would describe this more as a heavy duty night cream than a mask. It’s good but nothing amazing as I had hoped.

I love Paula's choice products so much, the quality and effect on my skin is always noticeable. This mask almost looks like a regular moisturizer but has a different effect as you leave it on over night. Really helps with dry skin or if your using a toner/exfoliating. Always makes my face feel nourished and clean.
